title: How to Invite and Manage Team Members
content:
CloudDash supports team-based access with role-based permissions (RBAC). The number of team members you can invite depends on your plan: Starter supports up to 5, Pro up to 25, and Enterprise has no seat limit.

## Inviting Team Members

1. Click **Settings** in the left navigation bar.
2. Select **Team & Permissions** from the settings menu.
3. Click **Invite Member** in the top-right corner.
4. Enter the invitee's email address.
5. Select their Role: **Viewer**, **Editor**, or **Admin**.
6. Click **Send Invitation**.

The invitee will receive an email with a join link valid for 7 days. If they do not accept within 7 days, you must resend the invitation.

## Roles and Permissions

| Permission | Viewer | Editor | Admin |
|------------|--------|--------|-------|
| View dashboards | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Create/edit dashboards | — | ✓ | ✓ |
| Manage alerts | — | ✓ | ✓ |
| Connect integrations | — | — | ✓ |
| Manage team members | — | — | ✓ |
| Manage billing | — | — | ✓ |
| Access API keys | — | — | ✓ |

## Revoking Access

To remove a team member:
1. Go to **Settings → Team & Permissions**.
2. Find the member in the list.
3. Click the three-dot menu next to their name.
4. Select **Remove from Workspace**.
5. Confirm the action. The member will lose access immediately.

Note: The original workspace owner cannot be removed. To transfer ownership, contact CloudDash support.

## Pending Invitations

You can view and cancel pending invitations from the same Team & Permissions page. Click **Pending Invitations** tab to see all outstanding invites.

## SSO-Provisioned Accounts

If your plan includes SAML SSO, team members can be auto-provisioned through Just-In-Time (JIT) provisioning or via SCIM. See article kb-017 for full SSO configuration instructions.

## Seat Limits

If you have reached your plan's seat limit, you must upgrade your plan or remove an existing member before sending new invitations. Upgrade options are described in kb-011.
